$comment: Information architecture of the local clone of pamidordesign.co (Dor Sharaby / Pamidor Studio portfolio). Hand-edit THIS file only; IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs. Structure derived 2026-11-12 from the rendered DOM of every live route (landmarks + h1-h3) and cross-checked against the clone's src/ files named in implementedBy. Paths in implementedBy are relative to the project root.

meta.source: https://pamidordesign.co (15 routes from its sitemap.xml) as rebuilt in this project's src/
meta.mirror: Local React clone at project root; routes declared in src/App.jsx
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill: rendered-DOM landmark/heading crawl + grep of src/ for each section's markup

categories.SHELL: Persistent site chrome rendered in normal flow or fixed on many routes: skip link, primary nav bar, footer, award badge, cursor.
categories.OVERLAY: Runtime/utility UI that sits above the page and is not content: intro loader, menu panel, route curtain, cookie notice, cart drawer, lightbox, drag cue.
categories.HERO: The page-opening composition of a route (title block plus its lead media), nothing below it.
categories.NARRATIVE: About-the-studio storytelling: statements, industries, working process, FAQ.
categories.WORK: Client project content: the project index and the blocks that make up a case study.
categories.SERVICES: What the studio offers, presented as a list of capabilities.
categories.ART: The personal art practice: the Art Lab teaser and the Art Lab canvas.
categories.COMMERCE: The art shop: filtering, product cards, product gallery, purchase box, cross-sell.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is to get a visitor to make contact or sign up.
categories.LEGAL: Policy text broken into heading-bounded clauses.

shell.skip-link.description: Visually hidden 'Skip to content' link targeting #main that becomes a bordered chip on keyboard focus.

shell.primary-nav.description: Top bar labelled 'Primary': the PAMIDOR.STUDIO wordmark linking home on the left and a two-line hamburger toggle on the right that opens overlay.menu-panel. On the home route it is rendered inside the hero and fades in after the intro loader.
shell.primary-nav.implementedBy: Inline markup duplicated in src/sections/home/HomeMain1Top.jsx and 13 src/pages/*.jsx files; behaviour in src/components/global/MenuController.jsx

shell.footer.description: Dark (night) footer: oversized wordmark image, the line 'Somewhere between structure and instinct.', contact email, Privacy/Terms links and copyright row; revealed by a scroll-driven clip-path that opens from inset(5% 7% 0 7%) to inset(0).
shell.footer.implementedBy: src/sections/home/HomeTop6.jsx (home) plus inline copies in 13 src/pages/*.jsx files; clip reveal in HomeTop6.jsx and src/components/work/ClipReveal.jsx

shell.awwwards-badge.description: Fixed black 'Nominee' award ribbon pinned to the right edge at mid-height, linking to the award site.

shell.custom-cursor.description: Image-based cursor defined in CSS that swaps to a pressed state while the pointer is down and inverts over dark regions marked data-cursor-invert.

overlay.intro-loader.description: Full-screen canvas-coloured loader spelling P-A-M-I-D-O-R letter by letter with a centre image chip that cycles nine intro images every 230ms; shortened on repeat visits in the same browser session, then hands off to the hero.
overlay.intro-loader.implementedBy: src/sections/home/HomeTop4.jsx + src/lib/home/introBoot.js + inline script in index.html

overlay.menu-panel.description: Full-screen navigation panel opened by the hamburger: staggered menu items (home, Studio, Projects, Art Lab, contact), a scrim, Escape-to-close, focus trap and scroll lock.

overlay.route-curtain.description: Night-coloured full-viewport curtain that covers the screen on in-site navigation to another path, swaps the route, then lifts.

overlay.cookie-notice.description: Bottom-left 'Cookie notice' card (analytics-only explanation, cookie policy link, Accept / Decline) that appears after load and remembers the choice.

overlay.cart-drawer.description: Side drawer labelled 'Cart' listing added shop items with a close control; mounted site-wide but only opened by an add-to-cart action, which is unreachable while every product is sold out.

overlay.board-lightbox.description: Modal image viewer opened from a case-study board gallery: full-screen image with (CLOSE)/(PREV)/(NEXT), arrow keys, Escape, focus trap and scroll lock.
overlay.board-lightbox.scope: Case-study template; actually opened only on Figcoms and Rise, the two case studies with board galleries.

overlay.drag-cue.description: '(DRAG ANYWHERE)' hint that follows the Art Lab canvas and disappears on the first drag, wheel or key press, or after a few seconds.

hero.home-intro.description: Home opening: oversized 'Dor Sharaby' name with the Dor/Door name animation, two-line tagline, five discipline chips, a large back-lit portrait, and an image trail that spawns artwork thumbnails along the pointer path.

hero.studio-intro.description: Studio opening: eyebrow, 'Studio' title, a facts list (designing since, studio founded, based in, clients) and the first question-and-answer block introducing the designer.

hero.case-header.description: Case-study opening (header#top): uppercase project title with project meta and the lead image or video.
hero.case-header.implementedBy: src/pages/Work*.jsx (+ src/components/work/WorkVideo.jsx where the lead media is video)

hero.shop-header.description: Shop opening: '(ART SHOP)' eyebrow, 'ORIGINALS & PRINTS' title and a short paragraph on signed, numbered pieces shipped worldwide.

hero.legal-header.description: Legal page opening: single-word title (Privacy / Terms) with its short preamble.

narrative.studio-teaser.description: Home 'studio' band (section#studio): a scroll-lit statement whose characters light up with scroll progress, plus the studio showreel video that plays only while in view.

narrative.approach-statement.description: Studio page answer to 'What makes your approach different?' rendered as a sticky scroll-lit statement (characters light up with scroll).

narrative.industries.description: 'Which industries do you work in?' block: a list of sector chips (technology, AI, fintech, cybersecurity, adtech, consumer brands, digital products) with an answer paragraph.

narrative.process-steps.description: 'What does working with you look like?' block: ordered engagement steps, each an h3 (e.g. Discovery & Research) with a short description.

narrative.faq.description: Single-open accordion of studio questions (specialisms, startups, etc.) with rotating arrow and 500ms height animation; first item open by default.

work.projects-list.description: 'Selected Projects' index: one row per client project with title, 'Jump To Project' button, role/scope definition list and cover media; the hovered (desktop) or centred (mobile) row expands while the others compress.

work.case-role.description: '(MY ROLE)' paragraph stating what the designer personally did on the project.

work.case-context.description: Second framing paragraph explaining why the project existed ('(WHY IT EXISTS)', '(THE PROBLEM)' or '(OVERVIEW)').
work.case-context.scope: Case-study template; present on Figcoms, iMotion and Israel Police, absent on Rise (3 of the case studies).

work.case-process.description: 'Process' / 'Approach' block: h2 plus a sequence of h3 steps (e.g. Research & Context, Audit, Positioning) with short descriptions.

work.case-chapter.description: Repeating media chapter of a case study: an h2 chapter title (e.g. 'The Board', 'Brand System', 'Photography') with its images, autoplaying in-view videos, board galleries or animated stat counters. Repeats 3-11 times per case study.

work.dashboard-finder.description: Interactive product prototype: a dashboard finder with a product toggle, removable filter chips, searchable collapsible field lists, time-frame buttons and live perfect/partial match ranking.
work.dashboard-finder.scope: Case-study template; rendered on Rise only.

work.customer-dashboard.description: Interactive product prototype: a customer dashboard with sidebar navigation, Overview/Settings/Lists tabs and a live 'Search organizations' table filter with an empty state.
work.customer-dashboard.scope: Case-study template; rendered on Rise only.

work.next-project.description: Closing 'NEXT PROJECT' link to the following case study, cycling Figcoms → iMotion → Israel Police → Rise → Figcoms.

services.skillset.description: 'Skillset' list of disciplines; rows slide in and their rules grow with scroll, and on hover a preview image follows the cursor with tilt while other rows dim.

art.lab-teaser.description: Home 'The Art Lab' band: rule, title, grid of artwork thumbnails and link chips into the Art Lab and shop.

art.lab-header.description: Reduced fixed header over the Art Lab canvas: wordmark link home, visually hidden 'The Art Lab' title and description, and a corner link to a case study. Replaces the primary nav on this route.

art.draggable-plane.description: Full-viewport infinite plane of 164 artworks in justified, colour-ordered rows; drag with inertia, wheel and arrow-key panning, and a cursor-following lens that scales and tilts nearby tiles.

commerce.shop-filters.description: Filter toggle row (All / Prints / Originals / Framed, aria-pressed) and a 'SORT: NEWEST' label above the product grid.

commerce.product-grid.description: Grid of product cards (image, type, SOLD OUT flag, title, price, edition) filtered by commerce.shop-filters.

commerce.product-gallery.description: Product detail media: 'Back to shop' link, main artwork image and thumbnail strip that swaps the main image instantly.

commerce.buy-box.description: Product purchase column: title, price, edition and paper details, description, and an add-to-cart button that reads SOLD OUT and is disabled for every current product.

commerce.more-from-shop.description: 'More From The Shop' cross-sell row of other product cards.

conversion.lead-form.description: Home closing block over a sky video: animated 'OPEN THE DOOR' title and a project enquiry form (name, email, project type select, message) with invalid / sending / sent / failed states.

conversion.studio-cta.description: Studio closing band: 'LET'S WORK TOGETHER' headline, a 'Start Project' button and the contact email.

conversion.drops-signup.description: 'Be first when the next piece lands' email signup for new shop drops, with idle / invalid / sending / done / failed states and a privacy link.

legal.clause.description: One heading-bounded policy clause: parenthesised uppercase h2 label (e.g. '(WHO I AM)', '(NO WARRANTY)') and its body text. Repeats per clause (9 on Privacy, 7 on Terms); the Privacy cookies clause also carries a 'Reset cookie choice' button.

templates.name: Case study
templates.notes: Section list is the union across the four case studies. work.case-context is absent on Rise; work.dashboard-finder and work.customer-dashboard appear only on Rise (between its chapters); overlay.board-lightbox is only reachable on Figcoms and Rise. work.case-chapter repeats per chapter.
